descriptions.text: Enchanted Toe Ring of the Splatter Skunk. Imbues wearer with +3 Strength and gives +3 to the skill Powerful Strike. Also, it’s a toe ring. It’s probably uncomfortable and it makes you look like one of those hippie assholes who sit around in a field juggling and hula-hooping all day.

Enchanted Toe Ring of the Splatter Skunk. (Upgraded) The item has been upgraded once. Imbues wearer with +10 Strength and gives +5 to the skill Powerful Strike. Also, it’s a toe ring. It’s probably uncomfortable and it makes you look like one of those hippie assholes who sit around in a field juggling and hula-hooping all day.

beats.headline: A toe ring, not shoes
beats.text: Carl's ten boxes pop out of his inventory and float before him in single file. The ninth glows gold and is labelled a shoe box, and it holds a toe ring. A goddamned toe ring. He needed shoes, damnit, not a toe ring. He is so irritated by the prize that he almost misses the last box opening.

beats.headline: On the index toe
beats.text: Carl reads it: three Strength, three to Powerful Strike, and the reminder that it is a toe ring. Mordecai rates the skill. Each level multiplies his damage when he isn't wielding a weapon, so at level three every kick or punch does three times what it would; with his Unarmed Combat and Pugilism skills his fists already do more damage than the cudgel or the poker, and a monk class might suit him. Carl sits down and slips the ring on. It adjusts itself onto the filthy, bloody index toe of his right foot. As the description warned, it is uncomfortable.

beats.headline: Upgraded off the wheel
beats.text: On Tito's prize wheel the needle hangs on the last spot before Nothing! and settles on green: a Scroll of Upgrade, to be read within twenty minutes. Mordecai warned him last time not to take anything off first. Carl reads it, his foot buzzes, and the toe ring glows. Ten Strength now, up seven, and five to Powerful Strike. With a base of seven in the skill and one more from his gauntlet, his damage is multiplied by thirteen.

beats.headline: Diminishing returns past fifteen
beats.text: In a training room on the sixth floor, a skill all his gear should lift to sixteen stays at fifteen. Armour and weapon enhancements lose effectiveness past fifteen, as Mordecai warned. The gauntlet's one point of Powerful Strike and the toe ring's five will still carry Carl past it, but he will probably need to reach twelve or so on his own first, and each level beyond comes with diminishing returns.
